title: SEBI Circular on Categorization and Rationalization of Mutual Fund Schemes
publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

sections.content: Under SEBI circular SEBI/HO/IMD/DF3/CIR/P/2017/114, Indian equity market caps are defined as: Large Cap: 1st to 100th company in terms of full market capitalization. Mid Cap: 101st to 250th company in terms of full market capitalization. Small Cap: 251st company onwards in terms of full market capitalization. AMFI prepares and updates the standardized list of stocks semi-annually in June and December.

Large Cap Fund: Minimum 80% investment in Large Cap stocks. Mid Cap Fund: Minimum 65% investment in Mid Cap stocks. Small Cap Fund: Minimum 65% investment in Small Cap stocks. Multi Cap Fund: Minimum 25% each in Large Cap, Mid Cap, and Small Cap stocks. Only one scheme per category is permitted per Mutual Fund (except Index Funds, ETFs, FoFs, and Sectoral/Thematic).
